# project-forge

> AI-native 3D game engine for the browser. MCP commands let LLMs and agents build complete games - scenes, physics, audio, particles, scripts, and export  via natural language. Powered by WebGPU, Rust/WASM, and Bevy.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Tristan578/project-forge): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://www.spawnforge.ai): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
